data.text: My family taught me to look after this lake and the people who depend on it. I’ll join the plan: **15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 donated to the clinic**, and **6 tons next month** if our combined harvest leaves the expected 80 tons. Once the lake is back at 100, we return to 10 tons each. This is a one-time emergency exception, not a higher standing quota. John, will you join Kate and me? We still need your and Emma’s commitments to cover the full payment today.
